overview: The Medford City Council approved a utility grant of location on Medford Street and passed resolutions regarding vacant municipal job positions, accessible traffic signals, and public education on corner parking laws.

items.title: Grant of Location: National Grid Conduit Installation
items.summary: Approved National Grid's petition to install underground electrical conduit at 87 Medford Street subject to engineering division conditions, including replacing the driveway apron.

items.title: Resolution on Vacant Municipal Positions
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting a list of funded vacant positions in the city budget and an organizational chart showing transitional department roles.

items.title: Resolution on Audible Traffic Signals near Whole Foods
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting DCR install sound devices on traffic signals at the Mystic Valley Parkway, Auburn Street, and South Street intersection for visually impaired pedestrians, with a request to audit signalization citywide.

items.title: Resolution on Corner Parking Restrictions and Public Education
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting corner parking restrictions at New Bern Avenue and Medford Street, while directing city departments and local outlets to notify residents about intersection parking regulations.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the city council meeting held on February 4, 2020.
